authoring.measurementMethod: Actual prop-v2 source surface height slabs, both independent limb envelopes, indexed topology, front/side/back/top/game views and existing base-colour UV samples. Interior joints inferred; no retarget or model modification.
authoring.anatomicalSides: Anatomical right negative X holds Club; left positive X palm open. Source faces glTF +Z.
authoring.calibrationRequired: Rest export must calibrate local arm axes/signs and nonzero downward upperRestRotation; keep Hand/Club local rotations zero. Strict source/native floor, grip, rigid prop and five-pose visual QA required.
authoring.propMaskMethod: Original-index mask of isolated lower club plus exposed gold shaft corridor at grip; original seam copies agree. All remaining source grip/fingers rigid HandR. Club is a direct child of HandR, zero local animation, so that two-bone held assembly has identical deformation.
authoring.readabilityRevision: Stronger bounded recoil and supported defeat; Giant clearer club sweep. Existing source geometry, measured bones, rigid ownership and numerical gates unchanged; fresh rest/export/native QA required.
